notes.title: Revision 2
notes.content:
On the level named "Exploring The Bridge", the object counters showed as 120 ladybugs, 0 aphids.
The level data has now been updated.

However, the counter data is cached based on save data, so in order for this to show the new correct totals, you'll need to open the level and close it again (per save file) or just reset the level using the trash can icon on the level selection screen.

Reported here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3121780/discussions/0/4625854988055305014/?tscn=1732383241
